svg.title: First-page research experiments from cohort selection to recorded integration
svg.desc: Versioned experiments select or reuse external local sources, freeze attributed references before new predictions, assess extraction and retrieval separately, and retain explicit failed preservation gates. Historical retrieval results do not qualify newer selectors.
